reasons.plausibility: Adding a dopant to suppress precipitates via boundary segregation is scientifically sound and aligns with known diffusion-control strategies, though the optimal Zr concentration is still uncertain.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of Zr-doped versus undoped alloys under the same irradiation and temperature conditions, followed by TEM and hardness measurements, provides a clear, decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: Improving tungsten-based alloys by controlling precipitates and hardening at relevant fusion reactor doses and temperatures is highly relevant, offering a practical avenue to address a recognized performance gap.
